newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK gold closes slightly firmer in two-way trade.
newsitem.headline: HK gold closes slightly firmer in two-way trade.

text.p: Hong Kong gold closed on Thursday slightly firmer than New York's lower overnight finish after a day of slow, two-way trading, dealers said.
Bullion ended at US$349.00/50 an ounce against New York's US$348.80/349.30 close on Wednesday and Hong Kong's previous close of US$350.20/70.
"The lcoal market has been very quiet, with a small amount of short-covering interest," a local trading house dealer said.
"Sentiment is mixed on the immediate trend and I think gold will stay range-bound, with upside resistance at US$355 and downside support at US$348, then $345," he said.
Local gold ended HK$13 lower at HK$3,229 a tael.
The carry over charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society dropped to -5.00 from its previous fix at -4.00.
